about_the_game:
After striking up a debt with folks who refuse to accept a failure to pay, Simon has landed himself into a tough spot. Backed into a corner by his own poor decision making he's forced to play "The Game" tonight, where life or death are his only possible outcomes. Winning the grand prize isn't enough for the people he owes, so a bet has been made to up the potential winnings and in return the organizers of "The Game" can make things more dangerous for Simon.

  • Be vigilant, psychos of all shapes and sizes have gotten the green light to kill you. Use your awareness to choose when to stay put, when to hide, and when to RUN.

  • Browse the dark net, with access to 52 websites, and uncover hidden pieces to a puzzle that will grant you life... assuming you can find them all.

  • Contend with multiple hacking minigames that will test your reaction speed, typing ability, and puzzle solving skills.

  • Successfully counter hacks to earn DOSCoin or hack into nearby PCs to mine some. Use what you’ve accumulated to purchase upgrades or services that aid in progressing towards the goal and help defend against future threats.

  • Race against NPC competitors who are trying to achieve the same goal. Take action against them to either slow or remove them permanently from the competition, but remember they can do the same to you.

  • Communicate with NPCs via a chat program to buy / sell services. Through your dark net searches desirable info will appear. Retain it in the notes app for future sale.

  • Risk what little cash you have in an attempt to win big on the slots, tilting the scales in your favor.

content_descriptors.notes: The game simulates browsing the dark net and the content found there. Some sites include illegal drug sales, satanic cults, and hitmen for hire. The game also allows you to gamble a fake currency using an in-game slot machine.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Core i7-6700 or Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 (4 GB) | AMD Radeon RX 570 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game is optimized for 16x9 aspect ratio

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Core i7-6700 or Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660Ti (6GB) | AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game is optimized for 16x9 aspect ratio

short_description: Navigate the internet's dark net, searching for pieces of a puzzle that once combined will clear your outstanding debt. Scan strange websites for info, hack into PCs while defending your own, and buy/sell goods & services, all while avoiding threats in this strategic, suspenseful horror game.
